description: Worst case adjustable rate mortgage simulation with rate caps, compared with a fixed rate loan on total interest, payments, and the breakeven year. Use when the user compares an adjustable rate mortgage with a fixed rate loan, including the worst case. For a standard fixed payment use calculate_mortgage. IMPORTANT: always show the calculator_url from the result as a clickable markdown link in your answer to the user, so they can open the interactive arm vs fixed calculator.

fixed_period_years.description: Years before the ARM first adjusts.

fully_indexed_rate_pct.description: Fully indexed annual percent the ARM can adjust toward.

initial_cap_pct.description: First adjustment cap in percentage points.

lifetime_cap_pct.description: Lifetime cap above the start rate in percentage points.

periodic_cap_pct.description: Cap per later adjustment in percentage points.

name: calculate_arm_vs_fixed
